correctness.rationale: For a mask uniform on the nonzero rank-one shell, direct character orthogonality gives the rank-s Fourier coefficient (q^(2n-s)-2q^n+1)/(q^n-1)^2. These coefficients decrease with s, and for n>=3 the rank-one coefficient dominates the opposite endpoint in absolute value, so it is the maximal correlation. This equals exactly the universal rank-at-most-one lower bound in Theorem 5 of arXiv:2609.18876v1. The complete-view statement follows from the product-channel spectrum and the source converse for any view containing an upload. Compact finite checks reproduce the shell counts, character averages, endpoint comparison, and converse match.

originality.rationale: The motivating preprint states only a finite-length factor-two gap and asymptotic optimality, and does not identify the uniform nonzero rank-one shell as an exact finite-length optimizer. Classical bilinear-forms association-scheme spectra are treated as background rather than new. Targeted searches for exact rank-one maximal-correlation masking and equivalent formulations, together with SCOPE archive searches by source identifier and claim family, found no prior coverage. The claim is only to the best of our knowledge, with elevated priority risk because the motivating source is very recent.

value.rationale: The theorem closes the finite-length achievability/converse gap exactly at the first nontrivial rank budget, gives an exact complete-view optimum, and identifies a simple rank-one sampler that strictly improves both samplers analyzed in the source while retaining O(n^2) rank-one masking cost.
